notes.title: Lost In Random: The Eternal Die (Nintendo Switch) Review
notes.content:
When I finished my initial preview of Lost In Random: The Eternal Die, my first thought was: “When can I play this on the Switch?” While it’s been something of a running joke that I’m CGM’s resident Nintendo fanboy, there are just some games that are better suited to the hybrid handheld. However, as has always been the case, ports of most games on the Switch can be a bit of a dice roll, and some are better left off the system—looking at you, Mortal Shell…

I was excited to dive deeper into Lost In Random: The Eternal Die, given everything I had experienced during my preview, but much like the world of Random, games on the Switch can be a bit chaotic. What’s on offer is a stellar game, somewhat held back by the limitations of the system it’s on.

notes.title: Going Hands-On with Lost in Random: The Eternal Die—Rolling the Bones
notes.content:
I’ll admit, I was genuinely surprised by Lost in Random: The Eternal Die. When I reviewed Lost in Random all the way back in 2021, despite my fondness for it, I had kind of assumed it would be a one-and-done—not only because it was a focused, linear game but due to EA’s performative support of indies and history of shuttering projects/studios. So imagine my surprise when this charming and unique little series got not only a follow-up, but a complete game overhaul.

The original Lost in Random was co-developed by Zoink and Thunderful, Lost in Random: The Eternal Die is being handled by Stormteller Games, with Thunderful now acting as publisher. CGM was fortunate enough to get to sit down with Stormteller Games to get a little insight into the creation of this new experience, alongside getting to go hands-on with the game itself. 

The first thing that was reassuring to hear was that a new studio didn’t mean a totally new team handling the project. As producer at Thunderful,... Read more

notes.title: Dev Diary #3 – 'A Sound of Fortune'
notes.content:
What does the world of the Black Die sound like?

In our third Dev Diary, [b]Sound Designer and Composer Ola Bäckström-Berg invites you into the eerie, enchanting soundscapes of The Eternal Die.[/b] From the smallest diceling squeak to the haunting melodies of original songs, Ola shares his vision of blending whimsy with darkness and action, rekindling the unique atmosphere of the original Lost in Random through every tone, texture, and tune.

[previewyoutube=4UqHQtdi1p4;full][/previewyoutube]

You'll hear how:
[list]
[*] Real-world recordings (including an abandoned lumber mill!) were woven into the game’s atmosphere
[*] Dicelings got their quirky little voices
[*] The soundtrack evolved into a full, layered score - featuring original songs performed by Ola and his wife
[/list]
Whether it’s a shiver down your spine or a smile from a squeaky die companion, every sound was crafted to immerse you deeper in the world of The Eternal Die.

Watch Dev Diary 3 now and experience [url=https://youtu.be/4UqHQtdi1p4]the Sound of Fortune[/url]!

notes.title: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die - Official Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
Have you tried the free [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2564520/Lost_in_Random_The_Eternal_Die/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/lost-in-random-the-eternal-die/9n72g399183f/?utm_source=lir_website]Xbox[/url] demos of Lost in Random: The Eternal Die yet? If not, now’s the perfect time to dive in and get a first taste of what awaits you in The Eternal Die! And while you’re at it, don’t miss our brand-new [url=https://youtu.be/BsxC6L4k-kE]Gameplay Trailer[/url] for an exciting preview of the full experience launching in Summer 2025.

[previewyoutube=BsxC6L4k-kE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Embrace the Power of the Dice[/h3]
A true dice-wielder’s greatest weapon is, of course, their dice! Toss Fortune into battle to unleash devastating attacks and build powerful synergies using the all-new relic and ability systems. The possibilities are endless - but will luck be on your side? Roll for damage and see if the odds favour you!

[h3]Master Your Weapons[/h3]
Wield four distinct, fully upgradable weapons - each with its own unique fighting style:
[list]
[*] [b]Sword of Sixtopia[/b] - Agile and precise for quick strikes.
[*] [b]Helleven’s Hammer[/b] - Heavy and mighty for crushing blows.
[*] [b]Sevendipity Striker[/b] - Deadly and swift for high-impact combat.
[*] [b]Lance of Lady Luck[/b] - A piercing force with unmatched reach.
[/list]
Combine your weapons with relics, abilities, and Fortune itself to craft a playstyle that suits you best.

[h3]Even the Odds[/h3]
Leverage the brand-new colour-matching relic system to gain powerful buffs and upgrades during your runs. If you fall in battle, fear not! You’ll return to the Sanctuary, where you can purchase permanent upgrades, take on quests to uncover the mysteries of the Black Die, and even change up your wardrobe before your next attempt.

Along the way, you’ll meet helpful characters like Mannie Chex, whose shop is always full of useful surprises, and Wager Rollins, who offers high-stakes gambles that could lead to incredible rewards - or dire consequences.

[h3]Escape the Nightmare Realm[/h3]
Use your skills, wits, and a bit of luck to defeat the game’s formidable bosses - some of whom may look eerily familiar. Navigate the twisted realms of Random and prepare yourself for the ultimate showdown against the fearsome Knight the Mare. Do you have what it takes to take your vengeance?

[i]Get ready to roll the dice and shape your fate in Lost in Random: The Eternal Die - coming Summer 2025!
[/i]

notes.title: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die – Free Demo Out Now
notes.content:
The dice have been cast! [b]The official demo for Lost in Random: The Eternal Die is available now on Steam[/b]  (and coming to Xbox tomorrow for all you multi-platform folks!)

[b]Enter the Eternal Die[/b]
Step back into the whimsical, dark fantasy world of Random - this time with a roguelite twist. In this free demo, you’ll experience the first of four enchanting yet perilous worlds as Queen Aleksandra and her loyal die-companion, Fortune.

Armed with your trusty sword, exciting ability cards, a new relic system, and, of course, Fortune, you’ll take on formidable foes and maybe even defeat the first world boss - if luck is on your side.

But don’t worry if you die. Each time you return to the Sanctuary, you’ll have a chance to upgrade your skills and weapons, catch your breath, and prepare for your next run. Be sure to chat with the quirky inhabitants of the Black Die, whether it’s seeking wisdom from Chance, honing your skills with Aama, or browsing Rack’s weapon stash (just be ready for his terrible jokes).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161701/a2e616ba1ae03ed2161e867f549fada68a874414.jpg[/img]

[b]Build, Experiment, and Adapt[/b]

Synergy is everything in The Eternal Die. This is your chance to experiment before the full release later this year, where you’ll be able to choose from four powerful and fully upgradeable weapons, 15 ability cards, and over 100 relics to customise your playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161701/8b9bfa6fe7b4dec1e2ffb9d96e3f04127fdeb2f0.jpg[/img]

[b]The Next Chapter of Lost in Random[/b]

Beyond the battles, this demo offers a first glimpse into the story of Queen Aleksandra - once the revered ruler of Random, now stripped of her powers and trapped within the merciless trials of the Black Die. As you explore, you’ll face enemies, encounter allies like Mannie Dex’s ever-changing shop and Wager Rollins’ risky dice games, and uncover secrets that may aid your escape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161701/d21b98ed54fd2bf5f72f3c3330fdb1a7aa3c89c4.jpg[/img]

One thing’s for sure - this is only the beginning! With the full release planned for later this year, there’s much to look forward to.

So, ready to roll the dice? Download the free demo now on Steam (or Xbox) and let us know what you think either here, online or via [url=https://forms.gle/SAkLtWwaFgVxz3ay9]our official survey[/url]!

[i](Oh, and if you’ve enjoyed your time in The Eternal Die, we’d love for you to wishlist the game as well!)[/i]

[i][b]May the odds be in your favour, dice-wielders![/b][/i]
